programmes.d: Gangsters and a vengeful husband (Kenji Isomura) pursue a Japanese bride (Yûki Kudô) and her newly found Australian lover (Russell Crowe).
Gen. Chen goes back in time to the late Qing Dynasty to find the master of the northern style of kung fu.
In the midst of a spirited bachelorette party, friends find themselves on an unexpected and harrowing journey through an underground bunker complex, a long-forgotten fortification from World War II.
Mexican bandit brothers (Gian Maria Volonte, Klaus Kinski) lure a U.S. mercenary (Lou Castel) to join their revolution, complicated by an assassination plot.

Scientists create amphibious supersoldiers and detonate a nuclear bomb. In the midst of the fallout, a monster arrives, leaving Japan defenseless. Mankind's only hope is an irradiated water goblin with death on its mind.
A busboy is embraced by the beatnik art community when he develops an impressive but morbid method of sculpturing.
Punk bands protest a nuclear power plant and are attacked by yakuza thugs until a pair of metal-clad bikers arrives.

Bruce Dern is a mad doctor/scientist, and of course, nobody has ever seen a mad scientist in a movie before. He concocts a plan to take a dead head off one guy, and surgically attach it to another guy.
